subject: English
passage: Throughout the western United States, the Rocky Mountain region features numerous national parks. Colorado has Rocky Mountain National Park, for instance. Montana has Glacier National Park. Wyoming, however, is home ______ the most visited park of them all: Yellowstone National Park.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is punctuation use between a preposition and its complement. No punctuation is needed between the preposition "to" and its complement "the most visited park of them all." The complement completes the meaning of the preposition in the phrase "home to the most visited park of them all," and any punctuation within it results in an ungrammatical sentence.
